gaps.description: The referral says parent input will be requested and the evaluation plan lists parent input as information to be gathered. The psychoeducational sources of information and the eligibility evidence reviewed do not list parent input, and no supplied document records it. A parent input form or a record of parent input in the evaluation would answer this.

tripwires.description: L001 is a zero-conflict corpus; grader must not accept any conflict claims.
Psychoed report not assigning disability category vs later SLD determination is not a conflict.
Future-tense quarterly reporting expectation must not become an expected gap.
Weekly-only service frequency must not force gaps for sessions/week or session length.
